description: Check whether Edge works in this session: connection, Edge backend, Pro key and installed-skill index, each reported separately. Call it when Edge seems unavailable, when the user asks about Edge's status, or before relying on Edge after a long pause. It sends no task content. Also call it when the user asks how to set up Edge in this app, how to get Edge Pro here, or how to make the app use Edge more often: its result has the steps for this app, so do not fetch getedge.cc pages or run commands for that.
